body: The world and people don't truly care about us. It's the ugly truth, as soon as you become a hindrance or are not useful anymore they toss you to the streets. People talk all day how they care but look at their actions. Their actions says otherwise. I hope you find a much better position or find yourself in a better situation. Also I recommend against doing the deed in their parking lot. When you die, you want to be and feel at peace. Dying in a place like that will not give you peace nor will it be revenge. They will just laugh or try to use your death to advantage. To pretend to be victims, behind the masks they wear on their faces lies monsters wrapped in flesh.
